inheritance: Only Battery law recommendations superseded; Cooling, Motor and five-family laws and all historical evidence unchanged

P_recommendation.job: one protocol robust to all five ambient contexts; optimize expected session minutes for the buyer-stated ambient mix and drawn starting SOC

ageing_state.scope: current supported initial state followed by30-cycle ageing programme; no independent SOH/restart input

P_recommendation.independence_recommendation: draw ambient mix, supported SOC and the two requirement margins independently conditional on this pinned cell and complete bank; ageing is a point mass, not a deployment-age claim
P_recommendation.cooling: OPTIONAL_REPORTED_ACTION_ONLY_WHERE_SEPARATELY_PINNED; no selected multiplier or implicit preconditioning

Q_recommendation.source: separate public/retired diagnostic pilot; protected selection remains operator-side

w_recommendation.P_reporting: unit weight per outer question; cluster by underlying bank
w_recommendation.Q_reporting: separate diagnostic summaries, no automatic official score or deployment weighting

objective.recommendation: sum ambient_mix_i * session_start_SOC0_to80_minutes_i among protocols satisfying all five charging/voltage/capacity limits; secondary capacity loss then bank order

time_observer.anchor_semantics: SOC0.10 exactly retains v2 session-start10-80 timing

aged_extension.recommendation: fixed common conditioning history on the same identified cell, characterized restart states and capacity basis before asking new30-cycle protocols; neither cycle10 trace nor Q30/Q1 is an arbitrary initial SOH input

audit_grid.objective: v2 proposed min worst25/35 session-start10-80 time

diversity.iid_conditional_expectation: sum_j [1 - (1-p_j)^k], with p_j = law mass of questions whose resolved best is action j; abstentions/unresolved are separate, not winners
diversity.pilot_target: HUMAN_INPUT recommend at least2 distinct resolved picks when P actually has answer-changing regions; not an achieved expectation, score gate or redraw rule
diversity.answer_regions: bank-bounded feasible-set/winner regions, not infinitely many answers from continuous thresholds; objective mix can change best picks inside a feasible-set region
diversity.exposure: all reused underlying cases count toward same E under #756/#760; no threshold/mix/SOC-label reset; retired publication only after all drawing windows end
diversity.none_feasible: KEEP_NO_REDRAW; power from diagnostic Q, not a conditioned all-feasible P

support_gate: must cover every comparator at drawn physical contexts, full-phase charge-plating/thermal reductions and qualified crossing; current input bounds alone are not settled truth or observer adequacy
task_projection: MIGRATION_REQUIRED_VERSIONED_OBSERVER_MANIFEST; derive ambient-mix objective and worst role-correct hard quantities, do not use unweighted mean or strata.w as the buyer objective
